crossRefs.note: “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, “who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty.”
saying, “What you see, write in a book and send to the seven assemblies: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira…
He said to me, “I have become the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. I will give freely to him who is…
Who has worked and done it, calling the generations from the beginning? I, Yahweh, the first, and with the last, I am…
This is what Yahweh, the King of Israel, and his Redeemer, Yahweh of Armies, says: “I am the first, and I am the last…
“Listen to me, O Jacob, and Israel my called: I am he. I am the first. I am also the last.
